job.title: Senior Software Engineer (Trading Systems)
job.description: Join our team as a Senior Software Engineer, building the trading systems at the core of our platform. We are looking for an engineer with a background in capital markets, trading workflows, or electronic trading systems. You will tackle projects such as feature expansion, platform modernization, and system optimization, ensuring high-performance and reliability in trading services.
responsibilities: Design, develop and test protocols and features to meet functional and non-functional requirements.
Ensure the reliability and availability of services developed by the team, addressing production issues.
Improve system performance for low latency and high throughput, crucial in trading systems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to execute projects.
